name: Should I contact my insurance company before or after getting a storm damage roof inspection?

mainEntity.name: Should I contact my insurance company before or after getting a storm damage roof inspection?

acceptedAnswer.text: It's generally advisable to contact a reputable roofing contractor for an inspection *before* filing a claim. They can provide a detailed assessment of the damage, necessary repairs, and an estimate. This information will be valuable when you speak with your insurance company, ensuring you have a clear understanding of the situation and can discuss the claim effectively with your adjuster.
acceptedAnswer.description: Get a professional roof inspection first to assess the damage and estimate repairs before contacting your insurance company.
